Overview

Oral (Uralsk) is a city in West Kazakhstan with a population of 300,000. A historic city on the Ural River near the Russian border, a major gateway between Europe and Asia. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.0.
